cases.title: Feedback pending
cases.given: Student reports wrong code at exact old scene anchor
cases.expected: Store pending; no confirmation, no model request or full-course hide

cases.title: Model reject
cases.given: Hard-valid draft with model severe/reject opinion only
cases.expected: Keep learning; opinion not a confirmed defect

cases.title: Confirmed local answer bug
cases.given: Trusted maintainer confirms exact answer with reproducible evidence
cases.expected: Disable affected exercise feedback/submissions, invalidate dependent facts, retain unrelated text

cases.title: Provisional practice
cases.given: No attestations, first complete group submitted
cases.expected: Store tentative exact-text comparison, course_only mastery effect

cases.title: Reliable first complete
cases.given: Answer+single-node mapping attested before complete, no help/history
cases.expected: One group quiz_attempt admitted under mastery-v1

cases.title: Partial attempt
cases.given: One of three answers supplied, no help
cases.expected: Store incomplete, no solution/comparison, no first-complete consumption

cases.title: Revocation replay
cases.given: Admitted answer later confirmed wrong
cases.expected: Append revocation/correction, replay valid old/new evidence atomically, stale path

cases.title: No node mapping
cases.given: Valid draft/group with no reliable node
cases.expected: Learn and practice normally, no mastery evidence

cases.title: Tutor help
cases.given: Owner sends exact-scene message with assistance acknowledgement
cases.expected: Mark scene groups assisted before send, one bounded tutor operation

cases.title: Clarification only
cases.given: Tutor explains simpler without update-course request
cases.expected: Immutable turn only; no scene/head/question change

cases.title: Historical attempted answer
cases.given: Old scene is now disabled
cases.expected: Owner reads own original input; withdrawn score/results, no wrong solution

cases.title: Ordinary exercise replacement
cases.given: New version of question or mapping activated
cases.expected: Keep old raw attempt; revoke affected contribution at switch; no new-answer regrade

cases.title: Cross owner
cases.given: User B uses A feedback/attempt/turn ID
cases.expected: 404 no existence details or content

cases.title: Forged confirmation
cases.given: Student POST contains confirmed/authority/score
cases.expected: 422 unknown fields; no privilege escalation

cases.title: Weak attestation
cases.given: Only generator and reviewer agree answer
cases.expected: No reliable-answer grant; remains provisional

cases.title: Retroactive promotion
cases.given: Attestation created after provisional first-complete
cases.expected: No new evidence or later practice promotion

cases.title: Multi-node score
cases.given: Question group mapping proposed to two nodes
cases.expected: No duplicate or guessed contribution; course_only

cases.title: Repeat under new IDs
cases.given: Same normalized question/answer set moved/reordered/newcourse
cases.expected: Same assessment_digest; no second formal contribution

cases.title: Help race
cases.given: Tutor/solution exposure concurrent with submit
cases.expected: Owner lock orders both; help first disqualifies independence

cases.title: Revoked first attempt
cases.given: First contribution revoked, second practice exists
cases.expected: No automatic second-attempt promotion

cases.title: Client marks own score
cases.given: Answer POST includes node_id or score
cases.expected: 422; node/score resolved by server

cases.title: Disabled question
cases.given: New attempt on confirmed-invalid exercise
cases.expected: 409 EXERCISE_UNAVAILABLE, no saved new score

cases.title: Wrong version
cases.given: Exercise version not in supplied scene/manifest
cases.expected: 404/409, no latest fallback

cases.title: Receipt leak
cases.given: Replay attempt key after old feedback withdrawn
cases.expected: Replay attempt_id only; GET returns withdrawn/null, not stale solution

cases.title: New source default trust
cases.given: Free-course evidence lacks valid admission
cases.expected: Reject; never inherit legacy no-catalog-assessment default true

cases.title: Later old quiz submit
cases.given: Legacy writer runs after new contribution revoked
cases.expected: Shared source-dispatch replay excludes revoked new facts

cases.title: Correction as gain
cases.given: evidence_correction audit has a score-looking field
cases.expected: Never reducer input; only trigger recomputation

cases.title: No valid facts remain
cases.given: Only valid new contribution revoked
cases.expected: Projection unseen; no residual mastered status

cases.title: Head changes during tutor
cases.given: Tutor output comes after bound head revision
cases.expected: Invalidated, no late response published or silent rebase

cases.title: Tutor contains private key
cases.given: Question context resolver sees hidden answer/config secrets
cases.expected: Exclude private fields; tutor cannot confirm or grant scores

cases.title: No acknowledgement
cases.given: Tutor POST lacks acknowledge_assisted_practice=true
cases.expected: 422, no assistance state or send

cases.title: Tutor while generating
cases.given: Owner has active create/resume operation
cases.expected: 409 OPERATION_ACTIVE; no automatic cancel/parallel second operation

cases.title: Tutor budget retry
cases.given: Tutor format fails, timeout or network uncertain
cases.expected: No auto repair/retry; counts shared40 pool; unknown outcome quarantines slot

cases.title: Unrequested course edit
cases.given: Tutor response asks to replace code
cases.expected: No head write; separate T002 preview and explicit revise needed

cases.title: Missing or duplicate answer IDs
cases.given: Submit group-outside or repeated question_id
cases.expected: 422; no fake complete

cases.title: Incomplete solution exposure
cases.given: Partial group submit asks for correctness
cases.expected: No answers/correctness until complete; score null

cases.title: New answer used on old attempt
cases.given: Old question superseded by edited answer
cases.expected: Never regrade old answer using new key

cases.title: Atomic rollback
cases.given: Mastery recompute or required invalidation fails
cases.expected: No successful confirmation/head switch; transaction rolls back

cases.title: Old catalog compatibility
cases.given: Quality decision targets new free-course only
cases.expected: No old signature/status/evidence rewrite

cases.title: Restore old contribution
cases.given: Maintainer corrects a prior false confirmation
cases.expected: No automatic regrant; new restore applies content only with dependencies valid

cases.title: Tutor before any attempt
cases.given: Owner asks current-scene tutor before starting any question
cases.expected: Record help for all context-involved question sets, no unattempted loophole

cases.title: Answer edit reset
cases.given: Same normalized question statements get different corrected answer or IDs
cases.expected: question_stem_digest prevents first-complete/help eligibility reset

cases.title: Previously ready tutor invalidated
cases.given: A ready tutor reply depends on scene later disabled for confirmed error
cases.expected: GET keeps student question only; status invalidated, markdown null, anchors empty, no stale answer text

cases.title: Legacy catalog stem match
cases.given: Completed catalog group copied to free course with same statements but corrected answer
cases.expected: Derive stem from original accurate legacy snapshot and reject new formal contribution; unknown original means course_only PRIOR_ASSESSMENT_UNKNOWN
